question: top basic categories having > 100 POIs in Lisbon, ranked by count desc
sql:
WITH cat_counts AS (
  SELECT basic_category, count(*) AS cnt
  FROM lisbon_places
  GROUP BY basic_category
)
SELECT basic_category, cnt
FROM cat_counts
WHERE cnt > 100
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

question: highest confidence POI per basic_category
count POIs by status type: Active (open), Closed (permanently_closed), Other
sql:
SELECT CASE operating_status
         WHEN 'open' THEN 'Active'
         WHEN 'permanently_closed' THEN 'Closed'
         ELSE 'Other'
       END AS status_type,
       count(*) AS cnt
FROM lisbon_places
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

question: restaurants within 1 km of Belém Tower (38.6916, -9.2160)
sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.2160 38.6916)', 'OGC:CRS84') AS geom
)
SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS name, p.addresses[1].freeform AS address,
       ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, r.geom) AS dist_m
FROM lisbon_places p, ref r
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, r.geom) <= 1000
ORDER BY dist_m;

question: POIs with name longer than this month's number
sql:
SELECT id, names.primary AS name, LENGTH(COALESCE(names.primary, '')) AS name_len
FROM lisbon_places
WHERE LENGTH(COALESCE(names.primary, '')) > EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
LIMIT 20;

question: basic categories where > 50% of POIs have a website
sql:
WITH cat_stats AS (
  SELECT basic_category,
         count(*) AS total,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE array_length(websites) > 0) AS with_website
  FROM lisbon_places
  GROUP BY basic_category
)
SELECT basic_category, total, with_website,
       ROUND(with_website * 100.0 / total, 1) AS pct
FROM cat_stats
WHERE with_website * 1.0 / total > 0.5
ORDER BY pct DESC;
